Description: 
 Job Title: .Net Developer
 Job Location: Jersey City, NJ
 Job Duration: 12 – 18 Months

 Required Skills: 
 • 5+ years commercial experience, preferably in distributed systems development. 
 • Strong C# skills. C# 3.0 minimum, 5.0 preferred. We make use of language enhancements such anonymous methods, dynamic type inference, lambda expressions, asynchronous programming constructs, etc. 
 • 6-8 years of SQL in  SQL Server 2008 or higher
 • Prior Capital Markets experience required 
 • WCF, particularly over HTTP. 
 • ASP.NET MVC. 3.0 minimum, 5.0 preferred. 
 • OR/M (Object-Relational Mapping) systems. EF (Entity Framework) preferred. 
 • Working knowledge of Design Patterns (GoF/PofEAA) & architectural styles, commercial experience preferred. Particularly: 
 • REST (Representational State Transfer), 
 • SOA/ED-SOA (Service-Oriented Architecture /Event Driven-SOA),
 • IoC (Inversion of Control).
 • MEP (Message Exchange Patterns), and, 
 • MVC (Model-View-Controller).
 Job Description: 
 • Unit testing experience. Test experience preferred, but NUnit, xUnit, or any other established unit testing framework will do. 
 • Implement SSIS ETL to generate input and output feeds based on the feed specs
 • Implement ability to source late feeds and trigger reruns
 • Implement data validation and data quality checks
 

 


 To know more about this position, please contact:
